objective: Prevent pause-held or scheduled review state from crossing a new run incarnation that reuses the same six-field identity.
required_change: Add an admission owner run-incarnation epoch distinct from the general authority/ticket epoch. It changes when active run changes away and back, including A->None->the same six-field A, but ordinary pause/resume authority changes do not create a new run incarnation.

Expose the incarnation in the authoritative snapshot/ticket. WorkerReviewScheduler must detect incarnation change before `_advance_schedule`, coalescing, or ticket issuance; discard old pending/ticket state and start the 60-second due baseline at the first observation of the new incarnation.
Do not reset the cadence on repeated idempotent set_active_run(A) observations. Preserve review count semantics and same-incarnation pause-held latest-one behavior.

Make the independent t=60 pause, t=61 A->None->A, t=120 tick test wait until the new incarnation's own 60-second boundary. Add before/exact/after boundary, A-B-A, authority-only pause/resume, and repeated-A tests.
verification: Rerun actual OMP if probe-visible scheduling code changes; otherwise explain evidence reuse.
constraints: apply_patch only; no workflow records, uv/local env/package artifacts, commit/push/merge/stash/reset/clean, or graphify restore.
